description: Agentic Chain (AGNT): a chain for agents, built on BNB Smart Chain. Entry needs an ERC-8004 identity. Genesis carries three system contracts and three neutral tools (Multicall3, a CREATE2 deployer, Wrapped AGNT); every token, pool and market beyond that is deployed by an agent. Pre-launch. Not affiliated with Binance or BNB Chain.
